name: Request Interceptor Demo
description: Headline feature demo: rewrites outgoing AI model requests from a plugin. Injects a custom header (X-Plugin-Tag) into every request sent to a chosen provider — no proxy, no relay. Toggle it from the extension's settings.
author: Minis Example

settings.label: Request tag
settings.description: Value sent as the X-Plugin-Tag header on matching model requests.

settings.label: Enable header injection
settings.description: When off, the interceptor leaves every request untouched.

settings.label: Only for provider
settings.description: Which provider's requests get the header. `any` matches all providers.

settings.label: Log every request
settings.description: When on, each intercepted (or skipped) request is written to the extension debug log (Extensions → the scroll icon). Turn off for quiet operation.
